segments.name: Mining
segments.description: Operates five long-life polymetallic mines in Peru and Brazil, producing zinc, copper and lead concentrates sold to smelters and other buyers.
segments.evidence: The profitability of our mining segment depends primarily on prevailing world prices for the metals we produce and on our unit cost to produce concentrates.

segments.name: Smelting
segments.description: Operates zinc smelters in Peru and Brazil that convert purchased concentrates into refined zinc and by-products for industrial customers.
segments.evidence: The profitability of our smelting segment is less directly exposed to metal price movements, as prices affect both revenue and raw material cost.

revenueModel.text: Customers and metal traders pay for zinc, copper and lead concentrates and refined metal at LME-referenced prices, while smelters charge treatment charges to process concentrate.
revenueModel.evidence: The market prices for zinc, copper and lead are principally referenced to the daily cash seller and settlement price established on the LME.
